topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning outcomes and connecting cellular transformation to histopathology practicals.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, proto-oncogenes, and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the classes of cancer-associated genes and illustrate their functional effects on cell cycle regulation and mutant protein behavior.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the stepwise accumulation of mutations during tumorigenesis and show how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reviewing learning outcomes, suggesting reading material, and previewing the next session.
